Attack range expands and ATK +70%. Immediately defeats enemies in range with HP below 120% of Logos's ATK, and deals Arts damage equal to the HP of the defeated unit to another random target.
Unlimited duration

skills.descRaw: RES <@ba.vup>+50</>. Attacks now lock on to a target, dealing <@ba.vup>50%</> ATK as Arts damage every <@ba.vup>0.5</>s. When against the same target, gradually increases damage up to a maximum of <@ba.vup>3</>x and gradually reduces its Movement Speed to up to <@ba.vup>40%</> (max effect reached after 5s). The locked-on target and the effects are reset when the skill is interrupted, or when the target is defeated.
skills.name: Synecdoche
skills.desc: RES +50. Attacks now lock on to a target, dealing 50% ATK as Arts damage every 0.5s. When against the same target, gradually increases damage up to a maximum of 3x and gradually reduces its Movement Speed to up to 40% (max effect reached after 5s). The locked-on target and the effects are reset when the skill is interrupted, or when the target is defeated.

boss_1.name: OpFor: Armor
abilities: Randomly selects a target and fires in a line, dealing Arts damage

[Woe of Extinction] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the Operator with the highest ATK, which explodes when it reaches the target, stunning them and units in the 8 surrounding tiles for an extended time and causing them to take Physical damage every second; <Armor Piercer> can be destroyed by attacking it several times when it is flying
When HP drops below a certain percentage, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and [Woe of Extinction] fires additional <Armor Piercer>
[Deathswarm] Periodically summons drones
Hidden Core

[Sword and Hammer of Olden Days] When specific conditions are met and the simulation enters the Hidden Core round, <OpFor: Armor> will appear in its final form and gain 'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher'
'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher' start Invulnerable; When shot down, transfer a percentage of the damage taken to OpFor: Armor

'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher' periodically fly towards the Operator with the lowest ATK and explode, stunning the target and Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles, and dealing Physical damage every second before returning to OpFor: Armor; they lose Invulnerable status when flying and will fall to the ground after taking a certain number of hits; when on ground, they are treated as low ground units and take more damage

boss_2.name: OpFor: Gun
abilities: Attacks prioritize units with the highest DEF
Attacks inflict Corrosion
Cannot be blocked.
ASPD gradually increases when attacking the same enemy repeatedly
[Final Judgment] Stops attacking and gains greatly increased Movement Speed, charging at the unit with the highest DEF and dealing Physical damage to units it passes by
Hidden Core

[Unending Confession] After fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round in the simulation, <'Gunshatter'> appears on the field, and Physical and Arts damage taken by <OpFor: Gun> is significantly reduced

[Blind Faith] Connects to all <'Gunshatters'> on the field; a percentage of damage taken by <'Gunshatters'> is transferred to <OpFor: Gun>, and allied units on the [Blind Faith] link take Physical damage every second
[Doomsaying] Continuously calls all <'Gunshatters'> towards it; <'Gunshatters'> gain greatly increased Movement Speed, become immune to damage, and deal damage to allied units that they pass by

boss_3.name: OpFor: Pipe
abilities: When on the field, continuously summons <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form; summon interval reduces when HP drops below a certain point
Attacks prioritize <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form
[Cracked Pipe] Attacks all <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form three times in a row, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis
Hidden Core
<OpFor: String> and <OpFor: Pipe> will appear at the same time after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round

boss_4.name: Sal Viento Bishop Quintus
abilities: Attacks two units with the highest DEF simultaneously
[Great Tide] Deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to all allied units
[Collapse] Deals Physical damage to multiple allied units
[Fragmentation] Summons its offspring to entwine themselves around allied units and Stun them
[Species Outbreak] Drains all Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle

boss_5.name: Lucian, 'Blood Diamond'
abilities: Has a chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks when not blocked. When blocked, swiftly moves behind the target and leaves an <Ominous Apparition> at the original location
Can use skills to deal Physical damage to the surrounding area; attacks and skills ignore a certain amount of DEF and inflict Nervous Impairment

boss_6.name: Alistair, Final Flame of the Empire
abilities: When HP drops below half, DEF and RES increase, and [Imperial Domain] activates two pieces of gear
[Expulsion] After some time has passed, deals Arts splash damage to all your units, and drains all Life Points
[Royal Decree] Locks onto an allied unit and their surrounding 4 tiles, dealing heavy Physical damage to targets within that range once and generating random gear on tiles within that range
[Imperial Domain] Activates a piece of gear on the field; different types of gear will result in different effects

boss_7.name: 'Samivilinn,' the Resolution of the Very North
abilities: [Icicle Fall] Attacks deal Physical damage to allied units in a column
[Surge of Nature] Inflicts Stun on an allied unit and causes the target to take Arts damage over time
After falling below half HP, takes reduced Physical and Arts damage and [Icicle Fall] and [Surge of Nature] both target an additional unit

boss_8.name: OpFor: Armor
abilities: Randomly selects a target and performs an Arts attack
When HP drops below a certain percentage, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and [Woe of Extinction] fires additional <Armor Piercer>

[Woe of Extinction] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the Operator with the highest ATK within range, which explodes when it reaches the target, stunning them and units in the 8 surrounding tiles and causing them to take Physical damage every second; <Armor Piercer> can be destroyed by attacking it several times when it is flying

0.text: Highest damage dealt to the Enemy Leader (victory only)

0.tip: Can only obtain trophies from Team Simulation

1.tip: In Team Simulation, you may skip once during Strategy selection

2.tip: Only some Operators from an Alliance will appear in the Dispatch Center

3.tip: The Dispatch Center can be manually refreshed even when frozen

4.tip: Reward Operators from promotions cannot be refreshed or frozen, and will be cleared when entering the next round

5.tip: Any resources in the temporary Bench will be destroyed when entering the next round

6.tip: Some special Alliances can be activated without deploying any Operators

7.tip: Operators' equipment will return to the Bench when promoted and have to be re-equipped

8.tip: Two of the same equipment will fuse into an upgraded version

9.tip: Certain equipment combinations can grant Operators additional Alliance effects

10.tip: Stacked Alliances persist throughout a single simulation, but their effects only apply while the Alliance is active

11.tip: Usually an Alliance has to be activated first before you can build stacks

12.tip: You can check Teammate battlefields during the Rest Phase

13.tip: You can check your next enemy group during the Rest Phase

14.tip: Easily retreat Operators by dragging them to the Bench

15.tip: You cannot make any moves after you are ready, but you can cancel your ready state any time, until all your Teammates are ready

16.tip: Only Teammates who achieve a perfect clear of their wave of enemies can help out during the Unite Phase

17.tip: Alliance stacks cannot increase when in Unite Phase

18.tip: During the final attack phase, two players will share one battlefield and cannot see the other duo

19.tip: During the final attack phase, all participants deal damage to the enemy leader
